sections.changelog:
### Version 0.1.235
- Shopee and TikTok warranty forms can size the fixed phone prefix from the cached marketplace mask
- Shopee and TikTok warranty requests with two phone digits stay on hold until staff verify the purchase
- Staff can create a Replacement order with a free item and customer-paid shipping
- Shipping details save the JNE service and WooCommerce shipping prices independently of tracking
- JNE fulfillment: REG and YES service edits persist and are used in JNE exports
- Fulfillment permissions: export, Goorita and Rayspeed routes use a shared staff permission check and reject anonymous requests instead of throwing a private-method error
- Performance audit: the health route passes the REST request to the bridge permission check, fixing a fatal error for requests without a WordPress administrator session
- Orders redesign: new orders screen with store-wide counts, rebuilt order panel, kit pop-ups and styled dropdowns, restyled Shopee and TikTok views, read-only order counts endpoint, WooCommerce status names, staff name on automatic order notes
- Staff dashboard: team notes endpoints (/staff/notes, stored in exacoat_staff_notes) and the overdue international orders endpoint (/staff/overdue-international)
- Products: /configurator/set-price sets only the regular price and keeps a running sale price (it used to force the active price to the regular price)
- Products: configurator saves keep the stored base price (regular price fallback, never the sale price), duplicates keep the regular price, /health lists features (set_price_keeps_sale)
- Security: configured add to cart accepts exacoat_custom_price and exacoat_addon_data only with a valid storefront signature (EXACOAT_CART_PRICE_SECRET in wp-config.php) and refuses the item otherwise; unsigned custom prices already in carts are removed; add to cart keeps only standard and signed fields (MKL pc_configurator_data, WCPA and addon_* fields are stripped)
- Configurator: profiles keep bundle_pricing (all parts price and per part finish surcharges) for the Camera & Back Glass product; order items get _configurator_data_raw from the signed cart lines (valid JSON readable by the warranty parser and the manager); bundle surcharge keys match in any case
- Security: headless checkout shipping is decided on the server; a courier choice needs a signed storefront quote (exacoat-ship-v1) bound to the order's destination and item count, free shipping and the shipping promo are applied from the order, store pickup is free and uses the store address; the public /warranty/submit-claim prices shipping from its own rates for the parent order
- Security: Indonesian Store API checkouts without a signed quote are refused unless they are store pickup (which gets the store address); the public /warranty/submit-claim needs order ownership proof (order key, billing email or the signed-in customer) and is rate limited per IP; failed Biteship warranty lookups are cached for 5 minutes; international warranty rates skip pickup, free and zero cost methods; courier rates convert with the global currency markup
- Security: public warranty rate lookups and claims never use the flat fallback prices (try later instead, failures cached 5 minutes per postcode and couriers); claim ownership needs the order key, the signed-in owner or billing email plus shipping postcode; rate limits read CF-Connecting-IP only from Cloudflare addresses
- Security: trusted client IP (signed storefront header, Cloudflare range check, never X-Forwarded-For); orders owned by customer id only; guest order reads without order key or payment links and rate limited; per-account sign-in limit; warranty eligibility always needs ownership proof (no suffix matches); affiliate portal and payouts by linked user only; BCA payment webhook requires a webhook token
- Security: no header rewrites REMOTE_ADDR (only a signed storefront IP); sign-in locks per email and IP and only slows across IPs; guest lookups and warranty checks gate only failed proofs; My Coupons by issued user id; marketplace claim proof by full phone or bound staff code (not the username); verify-order masks the username and is rate limited; BCA matches IDR bank transfers only; Midtrans fallback fails closed without a server key and checks the amount; affiliate seed runs once without a hardcoded email; a BCA credit delivered twice is ignored store-wide (mutation id or amount and description), so it cannot pay a second order
